Open Camera F-Droid repo

Signed releases of Open Camera (dev.opencamera.app), the full build from https://github.com/hoanglt1223/open-camera. APKs are the upstream release binaries signed by the developer.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://hoanglt1223.github.io/open-camera-fdroid/repo
